label: carboxylesterase activity
definition: A phenotype in which a microorganism produces active carboxylesterase enzymes that hydrolyze carboxylic esters to alcohols and carboxylates.
exact_synonyms: carboxylic-ester hydrolase activity|carboxyl ester hydrolase activity|carboxylic esterase activity|carboxylate esterase activity
